verdict.rationale: Teams exposes a fully documented, live, OAuth-gated public API (Microsoft Graph) confirmed by hands-on probes (schema metadata returns 200, auth-gated endpoint returns proper 401), plus extensive docs, SDKs, and a CLI (Agents Toolkit) for building/automating apps and bots. However, community feedback notes the integration is comparatively heavy, requiring the full Azure/Graph API stack rather than simple webhooks like competitors.
